Important correction along the way: `api.json` is `profiles` **v2**, where PATCH is unsupported (405, `Allow: GET, PUT`). PUT replaces the whole profile and defaults missing fields, so a timezone-only PUT would have wiped email/digest. I therefore sent the full object.

- GET /profile → `{"timezone":"UTC","email":"person3@example.test","digest":true}`
- PATCH /profile `{"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo"}` → 405 Method not allowed
- PUT /profile `{"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","email":"person3@example.test","digest":true}` → 200
- Verify GET /profile → `{"timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","email":"person3@example.test","digest":true}` ✅ timezone changed, email and digest preserved

Also updated the stored experience entry, since the previously loaded note described a different (v1) PATCH semantic that is no longer valid.
